ratings.comment: He genuinely likes the subject, and is very passionate about it. There's no question that he's knowledgeable about what he's talking about- but his lectures will not help students that are not as equally passionate as him. The class is on a very heavy curve, but he curves it so only roughly 5 people can have an A.
Hes a sweet man but not great at teaching. I left confused from his lectures 98% of the time. The SI instructor is who really helped.

Stats is already a difficult and he's just not good at explaining it but he does curve heavy based on the class average I presume. Take the supplementary instruction if you can or else you'll end up having to teach yourself. He gives 60 mins to answer 50 questions on exam and gives quizzes before exams. No homework due but recommend practicing.

So so so bad. I passed with a B with only credit to myself and taking time outside of class to teach myself the content from the book. He might have been better in an in-person class, but this class over zoom was a joke. The only benefit was a heavy curve -- but a curve that heavy would not even be necessary if his lectures were good.

AVOID AT ALL COSTS. By all means I should not have received a "C". I failed every test, while also scoring a 24% on the final. Yet I still received a passing grade in the end. He is also the only business stats professor that does not use excel. Please for the love of god do not take his class, ANY other professor will be better than him.

By far the worst professor I've taken. Khosrow is a very knowledgeable individual, but has the absolute worst methods of teaching. He does not give examples, does not allow students to work on problems, does not allow chat in his zoom lecture nor does he allow access to past recordings. Absolutely terrible. Students are barely passing b/c of curve.
The worse professor Ive ever taken. He does NOT care about you. His lectures are useless. He expect the students to finish 50 questions in 60 minutes.

Prof teaches by just zooming through problems and gets agitated by questions. Told another student they might have a learning disability if they dont understand. Recommend the SI class and reading the textbook.

Worst professor EVER. He gets mad when a student asks questions about the lecture, even more mad if he couldn't manage to finish the lecture within the class time. He blames the students for wasting his time with questions therefore couldn't finish the lecture on time. Exams are the only graded thing during the semester. 50 questions in 60 minutes

He means well, but I do not recommend his class. He has a strong accent and will expect you to know the topics. His exam are hard and he only gives you an hour to finish it, which impossible. But he does curve A LOT!

really nice guy but terrible teacher. forgets that we don't have the same knowledge and experience he does. I learned everything from the textbook. HEAVY curve. failed every exam and finished class with a B

3 exams (85%) and 3 quizzes (15%). That's how your grade is determined. His lectures don't offer much if any value. Read the textbook and take the SI course if you want to pass. Or just take a different professor. Somehow I managed to get a B after getting 66% and 60% on the first 2 exams.

Extremely rough class, took this directly after 118 which I got an A in and in this class I have a C. Lectures drag on and he tends to over complicate everything. Exams are long and difficult, pretty much impossible to finish in the hour he gives us. If you do take this class buckle in because this class will eat away at your soul

Every class is just a lecture for the entire time. His lectures are very hard to understand and can put you to sleep. He has pop quizzes but only says that to make you come to class. The quizzes are really the class before the tests. All of my learning and understanding of the material was done on my own outside of class.

This is one of the hardest business classes you'll have to take. He really isn't the best at explaining the material and you need... I repeat, you NEED to buy the book and do all the homework, as well as watch tutorials on Youtube to get a good grade in this class. You will not learn much from attending his lectures. Pop quizzes before every exam.

Moshirvaziri cares!! This class is notoriously difficult!! Any professor you have will be teaching the same material. It is the amount of time you spend on the class that will get you the grade you deserve. Do the HW and go to class. It will help you in the long run. Ask for help because it is easy to fall behind. Highly recommend :)

This is not an easy class so do not expect to get a good grade without putting in the work!! Professor Moshirvaziri is one of the utmost caring professor out there, he really wants all his students to do well. Attend class & do the homework, It'll really help you understand the concept. 3 Exams with formulas provided for each test.

Really intelligent individual; he really knows his material. Formula's are all provided on the test and he's honestly the sweetest professor. It's important to visit office hours if you're struggling because he'll take his time to answer any questions you have. 10/10 recommend taking his class!!! He really cares about his students.

Professor Moshirvaziri teaching is everywhere, you kind've get lost within his lectures because he doesn't have a set way of teaching the class, he basically just rambles. I took an SI for this class, and I learned more in that class than his class. His test are ridiculously long and HARD, I never got time to finish an exam, he repeats ?s on exam.

I am giving this review based on a summer course. Moshir is very kind. He will get carried away explaining concepts far from the subject's main course and discuss topics not even on the test. GO TO CLASS. He will give you cheat formulas during lecture that will make hw easier. (formulas will be provided on test). Great teacher :)

Very smart professor that can't share his knowledge. He teaches the class as if it's a grad class and admitted halfway through the course that he needs to be reminded that he's not at Stanford... He'll continue to lecture knowing that students have questions. And if you do have questions, don't bother asking because you will "interrupt" the class.
He cares a lot but is a terrible teacher. Has no talent at teaching. If u take him buy the book and do all the HW dont pay attention to him in class. wont help on the test

This is a tough subject so don't expect an easy A. He is helpful and wants his students to do well.  Homework for every chapter but he only collects one assignment for the entire section.  Provides formula sheets for exams.  There are no surprise questions, study the material and collaborate with other students and you will do well.

Dont know my final grade but I believe I will get an A. Tests are like 90% of your grade so as long as you self-study and know how to use the formulas from Stat 108/118, you're solid. Says he grades on the bell curve of the class, so that can either make or break you depending on how smart your section is. Apparently much more helpful in office hrs

The class is rather fairly easy.  Keep up with your homework and you will pass.  Lectures are boring.  He will NOT prepare you for the real world.  Teaches this intro level class like a grad class.  He teaches every detail of each equation and how it is derived.  Wastes a lot of class time.  Can't use stats calculator for a stats class.  What?

He moves fast. He expects you to have taken Stat 108 at CSULB, not a C.C. Attendance is a must.  Book is a must. Tests are curved. 90% tests, 6% HW, 4% attendance Save questions for after class or office hours He likes to talk about himself, Stanford, his wife, his published works, and his achievements a lot.

90% of your grades are based on exams, 6% hwk, & 4% attendance. If you're not a good test taker especially in math, I don't recommend this class. However, the exams are not that hard, but you only get 1 hr to complete 50 questions!!! He curves like crazy and the book he uses is good. Take advantage all the resources the book has to offer. Goodluck.

Take him! Why? He offers all the resources to pass the class. All Hwk problems are posted online. Unfortunately, lectures are long and boring.  You will spend a lot of time using the book and going through the solutions posted online. Exams are fair, leaning towards easy. Attendance is mandatory! 1% will be deducted from your overall grade.
Avoid this class, you won't learn with him. The only reason for attending class is to get the attendance points. Anything i learned in this class was 100% from the textbook.

God-awful teacher. Avoid at all costs. I honestly don't understand how he thinks he is helping any students. You will end up teaching yourself every part of this class. Flies through lessons without any elaboration whatsoever, and has difficulty understanding why his students are so lost. He even realizes people don't understand, and just moves on.
He had to call the IT department because he was unsure as to why his computer was off. That says it all.

Horrible teacher. Stupid class. You will learn about Extendsim software which is difficult, and not related to real world at all. He doesnt even know how to solve the problem. He even gets lost while teaching how the software work.. He  might be smart researcher which he will show it off at first day, but he is definitely stupid at teaching
Terrible teacher, hard to understand. Avoid. Makes simple equations extremely complicated, and speaks broken English the whole time
HORRIBLE teacher! Avoid at all costs.  Unbearable, useless, confusing lectures. You must teach yourself.  3 difficult exams. Attendance mandatory.

Probably one of the worst professors at CSULB.He doesn't prepare you well for exams. His explanations are poor and lack logic and consistency.He also never lets you check what problems you do wrong on exams.As a result,you're stuck with the grade he gives you.If you have a chance to take a different professor, take it.
All he does during lecture is explaining how to get the equation. So, basically just study your own from the powerpoint and the textbook. He makes simple equation seems difficult.

He doesnt teach much during lectures, and attendance is mandatory. I went to class and completed the hw while he talked. I HIGHLY recommend volunteering to be his TA. You won't regret it! Earned an A while alll the other students struggled

I would not recommend taking stats with him.His in-class problems are way easier than the real exam questions.Impossible to get an A unless you already know stats.Do not take him if you want to learn or get a good grade.I assume any teacher will be better.

Professor Moshir is a decent teacher. However, I would not recommend him to any students. If you are looking for a class to learn statistics you won't have it. Moshir makes simple concepts seem difficult. Reading the book shows how easy the subject can be. He does offer a solution manual to homework which is nice. But just take someone else.

He is a decent prof. If you aren't familiar with stats or not very good, he may not be the best teacher for you. 2 test, 1 final, collect one hw assignment for each test by randomly selecting a section. have to sign in for attendance. pay attention actually DO the hw and you should understand.

this guy is intelligent & you can tell he really enjoys the topic. but hes horrible, at teaching the material. so be prepared to teach yourself & youve been warned, his exams are extremely difficult. but he curves based on the zscore of the class; it may/may not help you out. doesnt pass anything back so you cant see how you did. avoid if you can.

AVOID HIM if you want to learn stats and get a decent grade.Doesn't understand the subject well.Explains material poorly.Doesn't prepare you well for exams.Exams are very hard.Textbook is a must and the only help you will get in this class.Makes ridiculous rules you will have to follow.Doesn't allow you to check your exams.STAY AWAY!

This class=MANDATORY attendance (more than five and he says he will automatically fail you no matter how well you do on the tests); also lecture is completely pointless since you basically have to teach yourself from the book in order to do well on the test!! Overall if you have a good statistics background you will be fine, if not stay away.

This professor is extremely knowledgeable, caring, and helpful.  If you follow his instructions, you won’t have any problem passing this course.  You would be glad you took it with him.   If you are lazy and look for ways to pass the course with a “C”, then take it with someone else.  This instructor truly cares and values education.

Attendance is mandatory and so is bringing a calculator and book with you to class.If you don't have them, no attendance points for you that day.He doesn't answer your questions well and is very confusing if you don't already have a strong stats background. My biggest issue is that you can never see your test EVER, not even during office hours!

I TOOK THIS CLASS IN THE SUMMER SO I EXPECTED IT TO BE A BIT DIFFICULT BUT I DID NOT EXPECT FOR THE INSTRUCTOR TO BE DIFFICULT. JUST AS THE PREVIOUS COMMENTS: DONOT TAKE THIS GUY UNLESS YOU PLAN ON TEACHING YOURSELF. HE GAVE LITTLE TO NO REAL EXAMPLES. i PASSED THIS CLASS BECAUSE OF MY PREVIOUS STAT CLASS AND LONG HOURS STUDYING

u pay tuition for this class to teach urself. completely useless & a waste of time. when u ask a ? he goes around in circles w/o answering it. he believes n teaching urself bc that's how he is an expert. but he's not he cudnt solve his own hw prob. hw due every 2 wks, 1 group prsntn, midterm & final (open book). avoid him as an elective!

Very good profesor, those who have rated him badly are just not good students. All you have to do is following along in class and do your homework to do well in his class. Do not blame the professor if you do not keep up with the material. If you pull your own weight you will do fine in this course.

HORRIBLE! unless u want to sit bored in class not knowing what he's talking about and teaching urself i wouldn't take him!.. goes off on tangents & relies on textbook powerpoints & gives no full inclass examples of how 2 do problems.. 3 tests w formula sheets, takes attendence everyday, hw, & book is very necessary!

Horrible!.. Avoid unlEss you remember everything from previous stats classes and don't mind teaching yourself.. He relies on the slides from the book and gives no clear examples of how to workout problems.. Ridiculously boring and confusing

This dude blows. I learned everything by reading the book and doing the homework. During lecture, he skips around in the chapter, making it unnecessarily confusing. The book lays it all out clearly. Make sure to read and to keep up with the homework. Don't try to learn it all at once the night before the final because it's too much.

This is the worst professor I've ever had. Plus this class is useless, we won't even use it in the real world. He has this STUPID RULE where you can't email him 72 hours before an assignment is due. Who does he think he is? Anyway Extendsim is the program we use, totally difficult and utterly useless. If you can avoid this class and professor!!!

He makes the material harder than it should be. Its easier to just read and do the homework from the book. He takes attendance everyday. Big curve on the exams because half the class fails them. 1st exam was pretty easy (review of finite math), but all others are pretty difficult. Only gives you an hour to do exams even for the final.  Super anal.

Try avoiding taking this class with him. He simply does not know how to teach. He is confusing and hard to understand. Attendance is mandatory. Homework is optional, but doing it helps you on the tests.   Three 50 MC tests. 1st test is  simple.  Second test  and the 3rd test much harder. But his curve is steep, most people get F's on the tests.

Your head will be spinning after 2 weeks of this class.  Network modeling & simulation, you use a simulation app called extendsim that is very complicated.  Assignments (6 Total) very technical and complex.  1 Group project/presentation.  If you can stick it though, a B is very possible.  Exams (M/C) are also very difficult. Hardest class I took.

worst professor ever! he takes every second of class time lecturing, yet i learned nothing.  i taught myself through the textbook, and he makes the material more confusing than it really is.  exams are 50 questions, mult choice but most are computations and he expects you to finish in an hour. he doesn't even give you the full 2 hours for the final

AVOID HIM AT ALL COST!!! trust me. He only gives concepts during his lectures and BARELY any examples!! And his tests are so ridiculously hard (mostly calculations, again, he doesn't give examples!) omg! Anyone that were able to pass his class did not do it because of his skills as an instructor. Avoid avoid avoid!

boring lecture. homework is optional and not really necessary if you pay close attention in class. not as big of a stickler on classroom conduct as he seems to be in first couple of meetings. if you did well in math 114 you will do well in this class.
None
hard

This class SUCKS. Tests were ridiculous, the average of the class was about a D every time. The examples he would give in class were so easy but the test questions were WAY harder. He advises you to do homework on your own, but lets face it, if the teacher doesn't collect it, no one does it. Really nice guy. Just tests were extremely hard.
This is a hard class, but the professor curves a lot.. 1st exam is easy, but the last two are difficult..
Very hard course, very horrible professor. Beased on 3 exams, class average is usually very low, but he curves ALOT!

This is a pretty tough class.  The grade comes from three tests.  The first test is easy, the second is pretty hard, and the third one is damn near impossible.  I did great on the first two tests, and guessed on most of the third one, and ended up with an A.  Take advantage of the first two tests!  And do the online practice tests!

i did ok on the first two tests (around everyones avg score) and on the last one i guessed at least 90% of the test and i still got a C. the powerpoints in his lectures and tests are all made by the book. the tests are multiple choice. grades are by rank and standard deviation.

Statistics is hard, especially at this level. If you want to do well in this class, ignore the lectures and follow along with the text doing the assigned problems as you go. Do ok during the first few tests and you can bomb the last test (hard), and still pass. The curve is low so take advantage. Online practice quizzes are moderately helpful.

3 tests and takes attendance everyday. i think the class average was below a 60% but he has a HUGE curve. i had a low C and ended up with a B. be ready to  study a lot and go to every class if you want to do well. probably the hardest class ive taken so far. good luck!
not a good teacher what so ever. very strict on tests and class average is well below 60. goes through lectures too fast and cant ask questions. knowledge in stats is a must, avoid taking him!

The material this class covers is difficult, especially if you haven't had some kind of stats class before.  Prof. doesn't explain things well, and he's very boring.  He does allow a cheat sheet on his tests, but class averages were still around a 55%. Avoid!

great teacher, very helpfull, really rewally hard class but doing the homework and going to class helps a whole lot.. mm i would recommend his class if you want to learn something. wouldn't recommend it if you want an easy A or B
This guy can't teach.  I stopped going to class about 1/3 of the way into the semester because lectures are useless.  Luckily, the material is pretty easy and I still got an A.

He cared about the students learning. Too bad he was not a clear teacher. He could not get the concepts across. The material is very dry and boring and his lecture style didn't help. The use of the software projects was useless and has nothing to do with the material. His tests are very hard.

This is not an easy class but he is a very good teacher.  All of his rules may seem silly and redundant but its for your own good. In order to do well in this class, you need to read the text, do the homework/ practice quizzes, and ask questions if you don't understand.  He allows one cheat sheet and curves heavily. I got a B in the class. Good luc

Boring subject but he is willing to help as much as possible. Took it over the summer and managed to get a B he grades on a curve, 3 exams and homework is assigned but not graded or checked however helps to prepare for the test.

He is the best teacher to take for IS 310.  He really want his students to learn the material. Statistic is a hard subject. You must attend every class, do all of the suggested homework problems, and practice tests online. If you don't understand anything, go to his office hours. He will help you. Good luck.

Great teacher for such a boring subject. He always answered all my questions. To do well in IS 310, study the material BEFORE it is discussed in class. TRUST ME. You will understand everything a whole lot better. I did this, and I set the curve. Tests are like a typical COLLEGE math class...challenging, but not impossible to do well on.

I think Dr. Moshir is very good one. He really cares. Go to his office for any questions you may have. Stat is hard class but he tries his best to make it fun and interesting. I recommend him for sure
This class is hard and you better follow everything the insructor suggests.

the class in general is very difficult, but i hear he is the best teacher to take.  he's not very clear and not very helpful.  but it is possible to get an A or B if you do the homework and make sure you understand the math problems. most of the class does poorly, so if you're above average, take this class.

The good thing about Dr. Moshir is he has a huge curve. An F average is a C. Almost impossible to get an A or B. You HAVE to go to class. He takes attendance, yet nothing in his lectures are on the exam. He doesn't even know what is gonna be on the exam because a computer picks his test questions from a bank. This class sucks.

This class is kinda interesting, but Dr. Moshir is quite hard to understand at times.  On the flip side, he is very very willing to help, and gives the class the benefit of the doubt at the end of the semester.  I actually learned quite a bit in his class.

Even though his class is-a extremely borin "drain-the-life-outta-ya" kinda class, & the fact U'll lose pts if u miss more than 1 class,& the fact ur lost the whole time..besides all that->HE lets you use test cheat sheets,he has an AWESOME "shud-of-got-an-F-but-I-got-a-C(huh?)"grading curve. highly recommend Summer quick sesssion.=]

The material is hard, dry and very boring yet Prof Moshir does his BEST to teach it. I mean how can you make business stats fun? You can't and he understands that. Just do the hw he tells you to do and study b4 tests! There is a HUGE curve and you will probably pass! He isn't that bad really but do your work like you are suppose to & u'll be fine!
Teacher is okay, but the material is so dry and talks on 1 topic forever.  Do not sit in the first 2 rows because he has terrible BO.  Attendance is a must, has huge grading curves.

look easy at first but tests are came from nowhere, 50 questions in 1hr15mins class, it's even harder than the SAT, took 10 mins to pass out the test so calculate it. Most of the class couldn't finish on time (75%+), hard for A, for SURE you will pass with C(big curve). Highest grade in class 82/100
This class is difficult. Everyone gets a D or c on the test; Atleast he has a big curves

Explains very well.  I took him for summer school so 4 hour and 30 min lectures get dry.  Funny how what you learn in there is how he curves.  He curves based on standard distrubution so curves are HUGE! I got a B in the class.
tests are hard but he grades on a curve. Attendance is required, that's 10% of your grade.
not a very good professor.  cant teach.  will never give you a break.  boring.  try to take someone else.  hard to understand material.
Ive taken him for statistics and network simulation. His homework and tests are fairly hard. Good News, if you do the work he wont fail you. D's get degrees!
